input.relationship: 提供一个双方属主能够采纳的兼容修改建议。src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount call src/cart.ts#Cart.total (backward)

evidence.reason: Signature changed to require a third parameter currency: string, but the body still ignores it; all existing callers pass only two arguments.
Call changed from applyDiscount(amount, 0.1) to applyDiscount(amount + 1, 0.1), which both omits the new required currency argument and changes the computed total.
Caller still invokes applyDiscount(price, 0.1) with two arguments, incompatible with the new required third parameter.
Caller still invokes applyDiscount(price, 0.2) with two arguments, incompatible with the new required third parameter.
Re-exported alias of applyDiscount now exposes a three-argument signature, breaking consumers that rely on the two-argument form.
Test asserts cart.total() === 18 and checkout(cart) === "USD 18.00"; the amount + 1 change yields 19, failing the test.
Test asserts applyDiscount(100, 0.1) === 90, which no longer type-checks against the required currency parameter.

result.userExplanation: 这两处修改共同破坏了 applyDiscount 的调用契约：pricing.ts 新增了必填的 currency 参数，而 cart.ts 仍以两个参数调用且把金额加了 1，导致所有现有调用方和测试都会失败。
result.suggestedAction: 请让 src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount 的 currency 参数改为可选（currency?: string）或恢复为两个参数，并让 src/cart.ts#Cart.total 恢复为 applyDiscount(amount, 0.1)，不要修改金额。
